view: Frontal (PA) upright chest radiograph; "L" side marker with technologist initials in the upper right of the image confirms conventional orientation (patient's right = image left)
technical_quality: Adequate penetration (thoracic spine visible through the cardiac silhouette), minimal rotation (spinous processes roughly midway between clavicular heads), adequate inspiration on the left (~9-10 posterior ribs); scapulae partially overlap the upper lateral lung fields bilaterally; costophrenic angles and lung apices included; slight image edge vignetting/burn-out at the right image margin (patient's left axilla).

devices.type: Round radiopaque external artifact with central lucency and two small nubs at its upper margin (most consistent with a snap-type ECG electrode/monitoring lead; a ring piercing is a differential) with a thin wire-like line extending superiorly from it
devices.location: Projected over the patient's left mid zone, laterally, at about the level of the 5th-6th anterior rib / just lateral and below the left hilum

devices.type: Radiographic side marker 'L' with technologist initials (external marker)
devices.location: Upper right corner of the image, over the patient's left shoulder soft tissue

abnormalities.finding: Elevated right hemidiaphragm (dome roughly 4 cm higher than the left, at about the 8th-9th posterior rib) with smooth contour and dome peak displaced somewhat laterally; differential includes eventration/phrenic weakness, subpulmonic effusion, or right basal volume loss

Mild hazy increased density in the right lower zone medially, above the elevated hemidiaphragm and adjacent to the right heart border, with crowded vascular markings; possible subsegmental atelectasis or early infiltrate versus crowding from the elevated diaphragm (low confidence)
Right hilum appears mildly prominent/dense compared with the left (likely vascular, low confidence)
Mildly prominent / unfolded aortic knob, likely age-related; trachea midline, mediastinum not widened

description_zh: 正面（PA）站立胸部X光，L側標記位於影像右上方，患者旋轉輕微、吸氣尚可，兩側肩胛骨部分重疊於上肺野外側。左中肺野投影一枚環狀、中央透亮之金屬密度外來物（疑為心電圖電極或穿環），並見細線狀影向上延伸；未見胸管、引流管或其他導管。右側橫膈明顯抬高（約高於左側4公分），輪廓平滑，右下肺野內側略呈朦朧增加密度並見血管紋理擠壓，疑為右下肺容積減少/次節段性肺不張或早期浸潤，右肺門略顯突出；左肺野清晰，兩側肋膈角銳利，無氣胸。心臟大小正常，主動脈弓略顯突出，氣管居中，縱膈未增寬，骨骼及軟組織無明顯異常。
